notes.title: 💫 Demo Update: More Achievements, Menu Leaderboard & Meaner Enemies
notes.notes:
Hey explorers!

A fresh build of the Sixth Force demo just landed. Here’s what’s new:


[hr][/hr]🏆 Achievements & Leaderboards
More demo achievements to chase.

Leaderboards now in the Main Menu — check top runs without leaving the game.


[hr][/hr]🛠 Bug Fixes & Tweaks
Leaderboards: fixed submission/refresh issues; times now display correctly.

Buttons & lashing: fixed cases where lashed buttons didn’t trigger or stayed stuck.

Level 2.2: added more enemies and disabled the pass-the-level shortcut.

Enemies: improved hit detection — they now reliably damage players and can be reliably defeated.


[hr][/hr]
Think you can climb the board? Jump in, set a new PB, and tell us how it feels in your Steam review or the forums.



Thanks for playing — more updates on the way. Keep that bond strong!

notes.title: Debut Festival 2025 Demo Update: Fun Sounds, Responsive Whip & Enhanced Tether!
notes.notes:
In celebration of Debut Festival 2025, we’ve just rolled out a fresh update to the Sixth Force demo—packed with tweaks to make every moment more engaging:
[hr][/hr]😂 Deaths Just Got Funnier (and then some!)
We’ve added playful sound effects not only for when you fall or “meet your end,” but for many other actions too, making everything feel more alive and cheeky—try it out! 😉


[hr][/hr]🔥 Sharper, Snappier Whip
Your mighty whip now stands out in the environment and reacts instantly to your inputs. Pull objects, smack enemies, and troll your partner with satisfying feedback.


[hr][/hr]🧶 Enhanced Tether Telekinesis
The connection between you and your partner during telekinesis looks and feels better than ever—more responsive, more immersive.


[hr][/hr]
Think you and your co-op buddy can master these upgrades? Jump back in, test the new feel, and let us know what you think in your Steam reviews!



🧶 Thanks for playing—more updates and surprises are on the way. Keep that bond strong!

notes.title: Demo Update – A New Level Has Landed!
notes.notes:
Hello, Force-Seekers!



Today’s update supercharges the Sixth Force demo with a huge new playground that twists the bond mechanics in fresh ways. Grab your partner and dive in!



What’s in the Demo Now?



2.1 — Rope Dash - Fall Guys-style mayhem, now in two-player co-op.

2.2 — Fresh Beach Horizon ★ NEW ★ Exploration and  puzzles with long-rope physics—your tether becomes a portable bungee line, so be ready for wild swings.

2.3 — Luminoid Reboot The fan-favorite luminoid phase-shift returns, now fused with an upgraded grappling hook.



⏱ Total play-time: 60 – 90 minutes of tightly-woven co-op action.



We Want Your Clips & Feedback!



Share bug reports, speed-runs, and “Rope Fail” GIFs on the Community Hub. Your reactions steer our next milestones.



See you on the line,

The Sixth Force Team

notes.title: 💡 Demo Update: Luminoid Level + Split-Screen Are Live!

notes.title: 💡 New Demo Update: Dark Mode, Stylish Checkpoints & Speedrun!
notes.notes:
Hey friends!
✨ “For takeoff, we’ll be dimming the cabin lights…”
Well, we’ve dimmed the lights — but not for safety. We’ve activated full Dark Mode, and it completely transforms the vibe.
Pair that with new effects and a speedrun-tuned level, and you’ve got a fresh take on the gameplay 👇
🌌 Dark Mode Activated
The demo now features full Dark Mode — inspired by retrowave aesthetics and nighttime sessions.
Think moody lighting, glowing highlights, and a surreal atmosphere with a whole new energy.

💥 Stylish VFX on Checkpoints & Deaths
We’ve added slick new visual effects to checkpoints and dramatic fails.
Success feels sharper. Failure?
Let’s just say it looks spectacular now.

🏃‍♂️ Speedrun-Ready: Level 2.1 Reworked
Our favorite short bond level just got faster and meaner:
• Platforms move quicker
• Timing is tighter
• And those blocks? They push now. No mercy.
Think you can beat the best time?
Share your run and tag us on socials — we’re watching!

Thanks for playing — and keep that bond strong.
More updates coming soon!

notes.title: Demo Update: Short Bond Level Now Comes First!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We’ve just updated the Sixth Force demo — and the first level now fully features our short bond mechanic.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44885228/504d365c0ad98bed3adc96c719059ddc1c3983a4.jpg

🧶 At the beginning of the game, the glowing link between players is short and restrictive. This means you’ll need to stay close, coordinate every move, and really communicate to make it through.

This level focuses on tight cooperative platforming — fun and accessible for casual players, but with enough precision to keep co-op veterans engaged. It’s all about rhythm, timing, and sticking together (literally).

💬 This was also the most loved level at GG Bavaria 2025.
We watched with joy as around 90 player pairs tackled it — laughing, supporting, and playfully trolling each other like true co-op partners.

So now this player-favorite level comes first in the demo — give it a try and let us know how your run went!

notes.title: 🚀 Sixth Force Demo Update: Smarter Enemies, Better VFXs and Fixes!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Another update is here, bringing improvements to gameplay, visuals, and localization. Here’s what’s new:

🛑 Enemies Play Fair – No more pushing players through walls!
🎮 Fixed Two Button Activations – Interactions should feel smoother.
🔲 Better VFX for Cube Telekinesis – More clarity and better feedback.
🇩🇪 German Script Fixes – Thanks to player feedback, we’ve improved the localization.

Thank you for playing and sharing your feedback! Try the update and let us know what you think.

May the Sixth Force be with you! 🚀

notes.title: 🚀 Sixth Force Demo Update: More Features, More Fun!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We’ve been working hard to improve the Sixth Force demo based on your feedback, and we’ve got some exciting updates:

🔹 Resume Feature – Now you can continue right from where you left off! No need to start over every time.
🔹 Bonus Level 2.2 Improved – We’ve fine-tuned it for a better co-op experience.
🔹 New Dialogues in Bonus Level 2.3 – More story, more personality, and, of course, more KIKI!
🔹 Tighter Bond Mechanic – The tether now keeps heroes together on screen, preventing them from wandering off too far.

Jump back in, give it a try, and let us know what you think! Your feedback helps us make the game even better.

May the Sixth Force be with you! 🚀🎮

notes.title: 🚀 Sixth Force Update: More Languages, Better Gameplay, and Extra Style!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We’ve been listening to your feedback and polishing up the game. Here’s what’s new in this update:

📝 Russian & German Subtitles – Now you can experience the story in more languages!
🎮 More Responsive Door Buttons – No more button mashing—interactions now feel smoother.
🔲 Hypercubes Last Longer – More time and more ways to cross the chasm!
🧢 New Cosmetic Additions – Because style matters, even in a simulation!

Thank you for playing and sharing your thoughts with us! Try out the update and let us know what you think.

May the Sixth Force be with you! 🚀
